items.title: Roy Haynes — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Sure I knew the Baroness? Why didn’t I? Yeah, I knew her, but I wasn’t thinking about going that direction.

ctx.x: Sure I knew the Baroness? Why didn’t I? Yeah, I knew her, but I wasn’t thinking about going that direction.

So, Roy Haynes is now a family man. Roy Haynes is coming off from a five- year stint with Sarah Vaughan, raising a family. So you’re having to juggle now, family commitments and a professional career. Did you find that challenging?
